settings.title: 14-day returns
settings.text: Send back unopened, unused hair for a full refund.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Orders are dispatched within 2–3 working days and usually arrive in 7–14 days in the UK. Delivery is free. You get a tracking link by email as soon as your order ships.

settings.question: Can I dye or bleach the hair?
settings.answer: Yes, it is real human hair, so it can be toned, curled and heat styled. Darker shades can be lifted by a professional colourist. Always do a strand test first.

settings.question: How much hair do I need?
settings.answer: For a full head most people need 150–250g: 5 or more packs of nano rings (50g), 2–3 packs of tape-ins (20 pieces each), or 150–200 U-tip strands. For added volume only, half that is usually enough.

settings.question: What is your returns policy?
settings.answer: Return unopened, unused hair within 14 days of delivery. See our returns policy for how to send it back.

settings.question: Which fitting method should I choose?
settings.answer: Nano ring extensions are fixed with a small ring, with no glue, heat or tape. Tape-ins are thin wefts that attach with tape. U-tips are bonded to your hair with keratin. If you’re unsure, message us and we’ll help you choose.
